# kilnworks-scheduler workspace

kilnworks-scheduler drives the batch kiln line: it preheats, fires and cools each batch of
ceramic and hands the finished lots to the packing gateway.

logs/kilnworks-scheduler.log is the scheduler's run log for 2026-04-02. One record per line:

    <timestamp> <level> [service] job=<id> stage=<stage> batch=<lot> [code=<fault>] dur_ms=<ms>

The code field is present on records that report a fault and its value names the fault. All
timestamps are UTC.

# kilnworks scheduler on-call runbook

- Dashboards: Grafana folder "kilnworks" (line throughput, gateway dispatch, kiln temperature).
- Escalation: plant-automation rota, PagerDuty service "kilnworks-primary".
- A GATEWAY_STALL record means the packing gateway stopped accepting lots from the scheduler.
- Nightly conveyor calibration runs at 01:00 UTC from the maintenance controller, not here.

turns.prompt: The kilnworks batch scheduler keeps a run log at logs/kilnworks-scheduler.log. Reliability is tracking a fault code, GATEWAY_STALL. For the postmortem, report the timestamp of the earliest GATEWAY_STALL entry, written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC). Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
